beats.text: Five Stoic lines worth carrying with you for the rest of your life.
"You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realise this, and you will find strength." — Marcus Aurelius.
"We suffer more often in imagination than in reality." — Seneca.
"It is not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters." — Epictetus.
"He who fears death will never do anything worthy of a living man." — Seneca.
"Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one." — Marcus Aurelius.
Learn one by heart. On a hard day, it arrives before the panic does.

source_note: Public-domain translations of Marcus, Seneca & Epictetus.
